name: pressure_tank_autonomous
description: Fully autonomous pressure-vessel FEM — closed domed tank with mounting feet; the prompt states the service context (6 bar internal air/water pressure, bolted at the feet) and the agent must derive the whole load model: the sealed INNER skin as the pressure surface (cavity region + pressure_mpa), the feet as fixed supports, declared in spec.load_cases; foot bolt holes in spec.features. fem declares NOTHING (use_parent_fallbacks).

stages.prompt:
A closed domed tank on feet — a sealed cylindrical vessel. mm, tank axis along Z, bottom on the XY plane.

- Body: outer dia 80, total height 120. Straight shell with a shallow dome cap on top and a shallow dome cap on the bottom (ellipsoidal/torispherical, ~8 mm deep each). cadlib.sealed_tank builds exactly this (dome_h for the domes).
- Wall ~3 mm everywhere — the interior is a sealed cavity, fully enclosed, no openings.
- 3 feet around the bottom: vertical lugs ~18 wide x 6 thick x ~20 tall, 120 deg apart at the base rim, each with one dia-6.5 bolt-hole through Z.
- One watertight valid solid. Nothing else — no nozzle, no boss, no extra features.

This is a sealed compressed-air tank under ~6 bar internal pressure, bolted down through the foot holes. Declare the load model: the internal pressure on the sealed inner skin (cavity region + pressure_mpa), the foot bolt holes as fixed supports, in spec.load_cases; the foot bolt holes in spec.features.
